description:
The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' is already open in JASP. This dataset contains item-level scores for the Big Five personality traits. You need to perform a Quality Control analysis on the first Extraversion item ('E1').

1. Activate the 'Quality Control' module (click the '+' button in the top module ribbon).
2. Select 'Control Charts' > 'X-bar & R' (under Variables charts for subgroups).
3. Set 'E1' as the Measurement variable.
4. In the 'Subgroups' section, ensure the method is 'Subgroups defined by observation number' and set the 'Subgroup size' to 10.
5. Examine the resulting X-bar chart. If there are ANY red points (data points outside the control limits), the process is 'Out of Control'. If there are no red points, it is 'In Control'.
6. Save the JASP project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/qc_analysis.jasp'.
7. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/qc_report.txt' containing exactly one line with the status: either 'Status: In Control' or 'Status: Out of Control'.
